name: hcapp_addKennelPhoto
description: Records a kennel photo after the app has uploaded the image blob directly to Azure Storage. Resolves the effective sharing preference (per-run override → per-kennel HasherKennelMap.PhotoSharingPreference → global Hasher.Preferences bit 0x40) and sets the initial status accordingly: 0=private or 1=pending_review. No sync delegation — photos are fetched on-demand via hcapp_getRunPhotos.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: Client-generated GUID for the photo row. Must be unique. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1231, errorType 12).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the photo belongs to. Must exist and belong to @kennelId. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel scope. Must match the event's KennelId. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: blobUrl
parameters.description: Full CDN URL to the uploaded blob. Required; empty string triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude where the photo was taken.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude where the photo was taken.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional short title for the photo. Defaults to NULL.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional longer caption/description. Defaults to NULL.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Device-library identifier (iOS PHAsset.localIdentifier / Android MediaStore URI). NULL when the user had 'save to camera roll' disabled or permission denied. Device-specific — only valid on the device that uploaded the photo. Defaults to NULL.

parameters.name: perRunSharingOverride
parameters.description: Per-run sharing preference override. NULL = resolve from saved preferences. 0 = keep private. 1 = share with Hash Flash (status=pending_review). Overrides HasherKennelMap.PhotoSharingPreference and Hasher.Preferences bit 0x40. Defaults to NULL.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Standard success/failure envelope. On auth failure or validation error: success=0, errorCode and errorType set. On DB error: success=0, errorCode=1931, errorType=19. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL. Mutually exclusive position with error detail rowset at index 1.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: PhotoResult
rowsets.description: On success: the inserted photo ID and resolved initial status. On error: standard HC6 error detail rowset. These two shapes are mutually exclusive at index 1.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Resolved initial status. 0=private, 1=pending_review, 3=public. Derived from effective sharing preference; shared photos from holders of the 'editPhoto' kennel permission (Hash Flash/GM/VGM/RA) are auto-approved straight to 3.

sideEffects: Inserts one row into HC.KennelPhotos with the resolved status.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on validation, auth, event/kennel mismatch, or unhandled errors.
Reads Hasher.Preferences (bit 0x40) and HasherKennelMap.PhotoSharingPreference to resolve sharing preference when @perRunSharingOverride is NULL.

codeSmells.detail: @maxPhotosPerUserPerRun is hardcoded to NULL, making the entire quota check block dead code until paid tiers are designed. Noted in the SP header as intentional (v2 placeholder).

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: All HC.ErrorLog inserts throughout this SP pass '<unknown>' for HcVersion. This is consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured.

codeSmells.issue: Validation for eventId/kennelId/blobUrl combined in one block
codeSmells.detail: A single error block covers three distinct missing-parameter cases (eventId, kennelId, blobUrl). If multiple parameters are missing, only one error is reported and the caller cannot distinguish which parameter caused the failure.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
